'''Karssk''', also known as '''Karssk the Mighty''', was a notorious [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] who specialized in targeting the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at some point before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Karssk attempted to kill the famous Wookiee [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Bowdaar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], but Bowdaar defeated the hunter in combat, solidifying his title as [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] greatest gladiator.<ref name="Bowdaar">{{TORcite|type=codex|Bowdaar}}</ref> However, Karssk's [[Death/Legends|death]] and "dishonor" at Bowdaar's hand led to a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] being issued on the Wookiee by the [[Trandoshani Hunters Alliance]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karssk was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Bowdaar in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Bowdaar" /> and the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' later confirmed Karssk's species and death.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> At some point during the development of ''The Old Republic'', Karssk was intended to appear either in person or in a conversation, as he is listed in the game's NPC files.
